text:
harper: Opening a WIP PR to add guidance on "redaction-on-export" for audit logs. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/912 — need SOC2-friendly wording and a short SDK example showing redact_on_export flag.
diego: paste the existing example so I can tweak it.
harper: current sample shows full event: `{"actor_email":"sam@example.com","tenant_id":"org1","action":"delete"}` — we shouldn't show that in docs any more.
anya: For exports we should demonstrate redaction fields like `actor_email_redacted` and show how to opt into full PII redaction. Legal will want exact phrasing around pseudonymization vs redaction.
frank-legal: Legal preference: be explicit. Suggest: "By default, audit exports can be configured to emit redacted PII fields (e.g., actor_email_redacted) or pseudonymized identifiers. Redaction is irreversible; pseudonymization uses salted hashes and may be reversible by authorized, audited processes. Access to mapping material is access-restricted and subject to audited access controls."
diego: nice. Also add a short SDK snippet (JS) showing `exporter.createExport({ redact_on_export: true })` and a small curl showing how exports look with redacted fields.
harper: Proposed docs paragraph added in PR: "Audit exports may be configured to redact PII on export. When redaction is enabled, sensitive fields (for example, user emails) are replaced with redacted tokens (e.g., `actor_email_redacted`) and cannot be reconstructed. Alternatively, customers may opt for pseudonymized exports where fields are replaced with tenant/user hashes; mapping tables for pseudonymization are stored separately and their access is audited."
frank-legal: Please include the explicit distinction sentence: "Redaction = irreversible removal of PII; Pseudonymization = reversible only via access to restricted mapping material and should be treated as sensitive." Also call out retention defaults and that redacted exports still respect retention rules.
diego: added JS SDK snippet to PR:
```javascript
// request export with PII redaction
await client.exports.createExport({
  scope: 'audit',
  redact_on_export: true,
  retention_days: 90
});
// resulting export sample row: {"actor_email_redacted": "<redacted>", "tenant_id_hash": "sha256:...", "action":"delete"}
```
anya: tiny nit: show `actor_email_redacted` as string '<redacted>' not null. Also add a note: 'redaction mode is recommended for customers that cannot host mapping material.'
deploy-bot: Preview build for PR 912: https://deploy.previews.redwood/912 — build passed; link-check reported one broken anchor in admin-export-refs, push nav fix.
harper: added nav fix, updated wording per legal, and a short FAQ: "When to choose redaction vs pseudonymization?" — answer: redaction for non-reversible minimization of PII; pseudonymization if you need re-linking for investigations.
frank-legal: LGTM with small edit: add 'audited access controls' phrase and mention that salts/hmac keys should be stored in KMS/HSM.
diego: updated snippet comments to mention KMS for pseudonymization keys and noted rotate-on-key-rotation. CI green.
harper: merging after legal signoff.
frank-legal: Approved. Keep conservative phrasing.
harper: merging now :shipit:. Closing thread.
diego: thanks all!
